mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 bc.content_type AS contentType, bc.genre AS genre FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl JOIN erp_bookstore_content bc ON bc.content_id = rl.content_id WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY rl.recommend_id DESC
SELECT TOP 1 content_id AS contentId, CAST(completed_at AS DATE) AS completedDate FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 'DONE' ORDER BY recommend_id DESC

SELECT TOP 1 i.item_id AS itemId, c.content_id AS contentId FROM erp_bookstore_priority p JOIN erp_bookstore_priority_draft d ON d.draft_id = p.draft_id AND d.is_active = 'Y' AND d.year = #{year} AND d.schoolyear = #{schoolyear} JOIN erp_bookstore_content c ON c.content_id = p.content_id AND c.state = 'Y' JOIN erp_bookstore_item i ON i.content_id = c.content_id AND i.center_code = #{centerCode} AND i.qty - i.loaned_qty - i.lost_qty > 0 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} AND rl.content_id = c.content_id
AND NOT (rl.status = 'HOLD' AND rl.hold_use = 'N') )
AND NOT ( #{lastType} IS NOT NULL AND #{lastGenre} IS NOT NULL AND c.content_type = #{lastType} AND c.genre = #{lastGenre} )
AND i.item_id NOT IN #{ex}
ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC, i.item_id ASC

SELECT bc.content_id AS contentId, it.item_id AS itemId, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.book_title, ''), bc.original_title) AS originalTitle, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.author, ''), bc.author) AS author, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.publisher, ''), bc.publisher) AS publisher, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.image_url, ''), bc.image_url) AS imageUrl, bc.summary AS summary, bc.keywords AS keywords, bc.content_type AS contentType, ct.codeNm AS contentTypeName, bc.genre AS genre, g.codeNm AS genreName, dc.name AS curriculumName, dr.name AS recommendOrgName, da.name AS awardName FROM erp_bookstore_content bc LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_item it ON it.item_id = #{itemId} LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code g ON g.gubun = 'G' AND g.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dc ON dc.content_id = bc.content_id AND dc.gubun = 'C' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dr ON dr.content_id = bc.content_id AND dr.gubun = 'R' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail da ON da.content_id = bc.content_id AND da.gubun = 'A' WHERE bc.content_id = #{contentId}

SELECT TOP 1 rl.item_id AS itemId, bc.content_id AS contentId, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.book_title, ''), bc.original_title) AS originalTitle, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.author, ''), bc.author) AS author, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.publisher, ''), bc.publisher) AS publisher, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.image_url, ''), bc.image_url) AS imageUrl, bc.summary AS summary, bc.keywords AS keywords, bc.content_type AS contentType, ct.codeNm AS contentTypeName, bc.genre AS genre, g.codeNm AS genreName, dc.name AS curriculumName, dr.name AS recommendOrgName, da.name AS awardName, rl.hold_page AS holdPage FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl JOIN erp_bookstore_content bc ON bc.content_id = rl.content_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_item it ON it.item_id = rl.item_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code g ON g.gubun = 'G' AND g.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dc ON dc.content_id = bc.content_id AND dc.gubun = 'C' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dr ON dr.content_id = bc.content_id AND dr.gubun = 'R' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail da ON da.content_id = bc.content_id AND da.gubun = 'A' WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} AND rl.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY rl.recommend_id DESC

SELECT TOP 1 rl.item_id AS itemId, bc.content_id AS contentId, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.book_title, ''), bc.original_title) AS originalTitle, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.author, ''), bc.author) AS author, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.publisher, ''), bc.publisher) AS publisher, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.image_url, ''), bc.image_url) AS imageUrl, bc.summary AS summary, bc.keywords AS keywords, bc.content_type AS contentType, ct.codeNm AS contentTypeName, bc.genre AS genre, g.codeNm AS genreName, dc.name AS curriculumName, dr.name AS recommendOrgName, da.name AS awardName FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl JOIN erp_bookstore_content bc ON bc.content_id = rl.content_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_item it ON it.item_id = rl.item_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code g ON g.gubun = 'G' AND g.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dc ON dc.content_id = bc.content_id AND dc.gubun = 'C' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dr ON dr.content_id = bc.content_id AND dr.gubun = 'R' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail da ON da.content_id = bc.content_id AND da.gubun = 'A' WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} AND rl.status = 'DONE' ORDER BY rl.recommend_id DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_student_card (student_id, card_type, trigger_count) VALUES (#{studentId}, 'RARE', #{triggerCount})
mapper.select: SELECT sc.content_id AS contentId, sc.card_type AS cardType, CASE WHEN sc.card_type = 'RARE' THEN N'레어 카드' ELSE c.original_title END AS cardName, CASE WHEN sc.card_type = 'RARE' THEN NULL ELSE c.author END AS bookTitle, CASE WHEN sc.card_type = 'RARE' THEN '/images/student_result/rare.png' ELSE ISNULL(cp.card_url, '/images/student_result/card.png') END AS imageUrl FROM erp_bookstore_student_card sc LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content c ON c.content_id = sc.content_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_card_path cp ON cp.content_id = sc.content_id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY sc.earned_at DESC

SELECT TOP (#{limit}) c.content_id AS contentId, c.original_title AS originalTitle, c.image_url AS imageUrl, 'DONE' AS status FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl JOIN erp_bookstore_content c ON c.content_id = rl.content_id WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} AND rl.status = 'DONE' AND YEAR(rl.completed_at) = YEAR(DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE())) AND MONTH(rl.completed_at) = MONTH(DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE())) ORDER BY rl.completed_at DESC

SELECT TRY_CAST(c.schoolyear AS INT) AS grade, CONVERT(varchar(10), COALESCE(rl.completed_at, rl.recommended_at), 23) AS date, c.original_title AS title, c.image_url AS imageUrl, CASE WHEN rl.status = 'PENDING' THEN 'reading' WHEN rl.grade = 'KING' THEN 'king' WHEN rl.grade = 'FRIEND' THEN 'complete' ELSE 'retry' END AS status FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl JOIN erp_bookstore_content c ON c.content_id = rl.content_id WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} AND YEAR(COALESCE(rl.completed_at, rl.recommended_at)) = YEAR(DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE())) ORDER BY COALESCE(rl.completed_at, rl.recommended_at) DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN sc.card_type = 'RARE' THEN NULL ELSE TRY_CAST(c.schoolyear AS INT) END AS grade, CONVERT(varchar(10), sc.earned_at, 23) AS date, CASE WHEN sc.card_type = 'RARE' THEN N'레어 카드' ELSE c.original_title END AS title, CASE WHEN sc.card_type = 'RARE' THEN '/images/student_result/rare.png' ELSE ISNULL(cp.card_url, '/images/student_result/card.png') END AS imageUrl, CASE WHEN sc.card_type = 'RARE' THEN 'rare' ELSE 'normal' END AS status FROM erp_bookstore_student_card sc LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content c ON c.content_id = sc.content_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_card_path cp ON cp.content_id = sc.content_id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY sc.earned_at DESC
SELECT badge_id AS badgeId, badge_name AS badgeName, badge_desc AS badgeDesc, category AS category, threshold AS threshold, param AS param FROM erp_bookstore_badge WHERE badge_id = #{badgeId}

SELECT b.badge_id AS badgeId, b.badge_name AS badgeName, b.badge_desc AS badgeDesc, b.category AS category, b.threshold AS threshold, b.param AS param FROM erp_bookstore_student_badge sb JOIN erp_bookstore_badge b ON b.badge_id = sb.badge_id WHERE sb.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY sb.earned_at DESC

SELECT TOP 1 rl.item_id AS itemId, bc.content_id AS contentId, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.book_title, ''), bc.original_title) AS originalTitle, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.author, ''), bc.author) AS author, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.publisher, ''), bc.publisher) AS publisher, COALESCE(NULLIF(it.image_url, ''), bc.image_url) AS imageUrl, bc.summary AS summary, bc.keywords AS keywords, bc.content_type AS contentType, ct.codeNm AS contentTypeName, bc.genre AS genre, g.codeNm AS genreName, dc.name AS curriculumName, dr.name AS recommendOrgName, da.name AS awardName, rl.hold_page AS holdPage FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl JOIN erp_bookstore_content bc ON bc.content_id = rl.content_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_item it ON it.item_id = rl.item_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code g ON g.gubun = 'G' AND g.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dc ON dc.content_id = bc.content_id AND dc.gubun = 'C' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dr ON dr.content_id = bc.content_id AND dr.gubun = 'R' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail da ON da.content_id = bc.content_id AND da.gubun = 'A' WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} AND rl.status = 'HOLD' AND rl.hold_use = 'Y' ORDER BY rl.recommend_id DESC
